layouts.name: Yas Marina South
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The operator historical brochure identifies the Southern course through the South and Marina sectors and hotel turns, returning via the independent short connection. The pinned 2019 public-node route retains the long Western curve, two Southern direction changes, Eastern hotel notch and short Northern connection, excluding both pit lanes and North/Corkscrew alternatives. The 2694.4 m independent length differs from the 2583 m timing scalar and 2.35 km operator description; fine historical corner alignment and short-connection mapping remain draft, without scaling the route. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 2694.4 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sources.evidenceNote: The historical general configuration retains independently identified Grand Prix, Corkscrew, North, North with Chicane, North Corkscrew, North Handling and South courses as separate paths from one consistent 2019 snapshot. The operator overview establishes six named main variants; the additional back-straight chicane is independently mapped and retained as a separate draft choice. Pit lanes, handling shortcuts, unrelated access roads and post-2021 reconstruction are excluded. Detailed corner, temporary barrier and timing-extent differences remain provisional. The independent unique branch distance is 6706.1 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.
